_readme: Seed data for the BTO launches feature. One launch object per BTO sales exercise. TO SEED A NEW LAUNCH: follow the curation runbook in BTO.plan.md section 8 at the repo root step by step (finding the Annex A PDF, extraction, geocoding, sanity checks, the reused-project-name check, verification) — don't wing it from memory, the URL patterns and edge cases in there were each hit for real. resale_flat_type values must exactly match transactions.flat_type ('2 ROOM','3 ROOM','4 ROOM','5 ROOM','MULTI-GENERATION'). Prices are 99-year-lease indicative prices, excluding grants, as officially quoted by HDB unless the launch has not happened yet (see section 8.9 for provisional/unofficial launches).

launches._curation_note: Predates HDB's Oct 2024 Standard/Plus/Prime classification framework — used the older Non-Mature Town / Mature Town system (no PLH project in this launch), preserved as-is. This launch's official Annex A/pricing PDF was NEVER successfully archived anywhere (only a dead 403 Wayback capture exists at hdb.gov.sg/-/media/doc/CCG/17112020-Annex-A1.ashx) — reconstructed instead from (a) HDB's own public sales brochures at housingmap.sg/hdb-brochures/bto-2020-11/, whose site-plan page (page 11 or nearby, varies by brochure) has a rasterized per-block unit-mix table image (not extractable as text — must render the PDF page as an image) giving exact per-flat-type unit counts, cross-checked against each floor-plan page's printed sqm, and (b) PropertyGuru's per-project 'review' articles (distinct from its general launch-overview article) and the overview article's own FAQ section further down the page, both of which reproduce real per-flat-type price ranges. All unit totals reconciled exactly to independently-known project totals, and the launch-wide sum (5,795) matches the confirmed BTO-only headline (the press release's 11,015 figure includes SBF). No waiting-time data was found for this launch — waiting_months is null for every project. ParkView @ Bidadari's 4-Room row combines two floor-plan variants (93 sqm standard, 96 sqm with balcony) sharing one unit count/price range in the source data — same combined-row treatment used elsewhere in this dataset for split floor areas. Garden Court/Garden Terrace @ Tengah share identical per-flat-type pricing (both are literally labelled with the same 'Tengah BTO Flat Type' price table in the source) despite being two separate HDB projects with independently-verified unit-mix tables.

launches.label: August 2020 BTO
launches._curation_note: Predates HDB's Oct 2024 Standard/Plus/Prime classification framework — used the older Non-Mature/Mature Estates system, preserved as-is. This launch's official Annex A PDF is genuinely unrecoverable (live URL dead, zero Wayback captures at all for that path — worse than Nov 2020, which at least had a dead 403 capture). Reconstructed via the housingmap.sg/bto/ fallback: real per-flat-type unit counts and sqm came from each project's HDB sales brochure's rasterized unit-mix table + floor-plan pages (same method as Nov 2020); real 'From' (minimum) prices per flat type came from PropertyGuru's launch-overview article (web.archive.org capture) and its per-town infographic breakdown, cross-verified against the Keat Hong Verge project-specific review article. All unit totals reconcile exactly: each project's total matches its independently-known figure, and the full launch sums to exactly 7,862 units (matching the press release headline). HOWEVER, every price_max value, plus the 2-Room Flexi Type 2 price_min for every project (only Type 1's floor price was ever separately quoted), is ESTIMATED (not sourced from an official HDB document) — extrapolated from this project's real verified 'From' (minimum) price using the min-to-max spread ratio observed in the nearest verified same-classification comparable launch (Sun Sails for Non-Mature Town, Bishan Ridges/Tampines GreenEmerald blend for Mature Town, both Nov 2020, 3 months later). Do not treat as an official HDB figure. Costa Grove's brochure unit-mix table also lists 200 rental flats (58x 1-Room + 142x 2-Room, not for sale to the public) alongside the 1,070 home-ownership units — correctly excluded from flats[]. Several projects (Bishan Towers, Costa Grove) have a 4-Room and/or 3-Room/5-Room row spanning two floor-plan variants (a smaller standard unit and a larger balcony unit) sharing one combined unit count in the source brochure — the smaller/standard sqm is stored, matching the convention used elsewhere in this dataset for the same situation. Parc Residences @ Tengah's town (TENGAH) has zero rows in our own transactions table (same situation as other Tengah-precinct projects across this dataset) — its town-level comps fallback will be empty. Tampines GreenOpal geocodes to Bedok at every radius tested, but is explicitly named and press-release-grouped as a Tampines project — town is set to TAMPINES per the official designation, same treatment as other boundary-adjacent projects elsewhere in this dataset. No waiting-time data was found for this launch — waiting_months is null for every project.
